comparison.objective: Wring a strep-test swab against its tube while rotating it, then withdraw it under squeeze.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual compliant-container squeezing, repeated swab rotation, and coordinated withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Required squeeze/contact and extraction state with liquid preservation; versions specify rotation and release measurements.
comparison.reason: Liquid-sample extraction from a swab does not test dry particulate screening or tool-induced granular flow.
